Title: The Bells

The episode opens with Daenerys (Emilia Clarke) and her army approaching King's Landing. Qyburn informs Cersei (Lena Headey) that Euron Greyjoy (Pilou Asbæk) has arrived with the Golden Company.

In the Dragonpit, Tyrion (Peter Dinklage) tries to reason with Jaime (Nikolaj Coster-Waldau), urging him to leave Cersei and join the fight against the army of the dead. Jaime initially refuses but later decides to leave, bidding a tearful goodbye to Tyrion.

Meanwhile, Arya (Maisie Williams) and the Hound (Rory McCann) discuss their plans. Arya intends to kill Cersei, while the Hound plans to find and kill the Mountain (Hafthór Júlíus Björnsson).

Daenerys and Drogon begin the attack on King's Landing. The city's defenses are quickly overwhelmed, and the dragon's fire causes widespread destruction. Qyburn's scorpions prove ineffective against Drogon.

Jaime, Bronn (Jerome Flynn), and Euron sail towards King's Landing, intending to kill Daenerys. However, they are intercepted by the Greyjoy fleet, and Euron is killed. Jaime and Bronn manage to reach the city.

Inside King's Landing, the Lannister forces, including the Mountain, are struggling to hold off the Unsullied and Dothraki. Qyburn reveals the new weapon, a giant crossbow, to Cersei.

Tyrion, Varys (Conleth Hill), and Grey Worm (Jacob Anderson) discuss their concerns about Daenerys' actions. Tyrion attempts to reason with her, but she is unresponsive.

The Hound and Arya sneak into the Red Keep, evading the Mountain. Arya manages to reach Cersei, but instead of killing her, she reveals that she is the one Jaqen H'ghar spoke of, and spares Cersei's life.

Meanwhile, the city continues to burn. Daenerys, on Drogon, flies over the destruction, seemingly unaware of the chaos she has caused. The episode ends with Jaime finding Cersei in the Red Keep, and they share a final embrace before the building collapses on them.

The episode concludes with Jon Snow (Kit Harington) finding Tyrion in the wreckage of the Dragonpit, mourning the loss of his family. The Night King and his army are still marching towards Winterfell.

Here's a transcript of the latest episode, "The Bells" (Season 8, Episode 3):

INT. KING'S LANDING - NIGHT

The episode opens with the living gathered around the Iron Throne, mourning the death of Daenerys Targaryen. Jon Snow, now revealed as Aegon Targaryen, stands beside Daenerys' body, his face etched with grief.

SEVERAL LIVING - V.O.
We thought we knew the truth. We thought we knew the past. But now, we realize that the past was just a lie.

CUT TO:

INT. DAENERYS' BEDCHAMBER - NIGHT

Daenerys' loyal advisor, Missandei, stands before her body, mourning the loss of her friend.

MISSANDEI
(sobs)
I will never forget the way she smiled. The way she laughed. The way she loved.

CUT TO:

INT. KING'S LANDING - LIVING ROOM - NIGHT

Jon Snow, now dressed in a black cloak, sits on a couch, looking out the window. Arya Stark enters, her face somber.

ARYA
Jon, what's wrong? You've been distant all day.

JON
(looks at Arya)
I don't know if I can do this, Arya. I don't know if I can be a king.

ARYA
(reassuringly)
You've always been a king, Jon. You just need to remember it.

CUT TO:

INT. RED KEEP - NIGHT

The remaining members of the Night's Watch, including Samwell Tarly, Davos Seaworth, and Jon Snow, stand together, discussing the implications of Daenerys' death.

SAMWELL
(frustrated)
We can't just let her die. We have to do something.

DAVOS
(calmly)
We've tried, Samwell. We've tried to reason with her. But she's beyond reason.

JON
(looking out the window)
I know. I know. But I have to try. For the people. For the realm.

CUT TO:

EXT. KING'S LANDING - NIGHT

The living, led by Cersei Lannister, march towards the Red Keep, determined to take the throne for themselves.

CERSEI
(anger in her voice)
We will not be denied. We will not be ignored. We will take the Iron Throne, no matter what it takes.

The episode ends with the sound of drums beating in the distance, as the living prepare to storm the Red Keep.

SEVERAL LIVING - V.O.
The war has begun. The battle for the throne has begun. But at what cost?

FADE TO BLACK.

[The episode begins with a shot of King's Landing as Daenerys Targaryen's army approaches the city. The bells of the city ring as a sign of surrender. Daenerys and her council discuss their next move.]

Daenerys: The bells ring. This is our victory.

Tyrion: My queen, we have won.

Daenerys: We have won the war, but not the peace.

Grey Worm: My queen, we have been waiting for this moment.

Daenerys: I know. But we will not show mercy to those who deserve it least.

[The scene cuts to Cersei Lannister and Jaime Lannister in the Red Keep. They hear the bells ringing.]

Cersei: They ring the bells.

Jaime: It's over.

Cersei: (smiling) Not for us.

[The scene cuts to Daenerys' army entering the city. They begin to destroy everything in their path.]

Daenerys: (to Tyrion) Burn them all.

[The army sets fire to the city. The scene cuts to Arya Stark, who is watching the destruction from a distance.]

Arya: (to the Hound) We have to go.

The Hound: (to Arya) I know.

[The scene cuts to Jon Snow, who is also watching the destruction. He sees Daenerys ordering the burning of the city.]

Jon: (to Davos) We have to stop this.

Davos: (to Jon) How?

Jon: (to Davos) We have to tell her.

[The scene cuts to Jon and Davos entering the Red Keep. They find Tyrion and Daenerys.]

Jon: Your Grace, we have to stop this.

Daenerys: (to Jon) I have waited a long time for this.

Jon: (to Daenerys) I know, but this is not the way.

Daenerys: (to Jon) I am the Queen of the Andals, the Rhoynar, and the First Men. I am the Khaleesi of the Great Grass Sea, the Breaker of Chains, and the Mother of Dragons. I am the Daughter of the Harpy, the Queen of Meereen, the Liberator of Slaver's Bay. I am the Queen of Westeros, and I swear to you all, I will take what is mine with fire and blood.

[The scene cuts to the destruction continuing. The army sets fire to the Red Keep. The scene cuts to Jaime and Cersei.]

Jaime: (to Cersei) We have to leave.

Cersei: (to Jaime) I will not leave you.

Jaime: (to Cersei) You have to.

Cersei: (to Jaime) I will not.

[The scene cuts to Arya, who is running through the city. She sees the Hound.]

Arya: (to the Hound) Come with me.

The Hound: (to Arya) I'm not going to die in a brothel.

[The scene cuts to Jon and Davos, who are trying to stop Daenerys.]

Jon: (to Daenerys) Please, Your Grace.

Daenerys: (to Jon) I have been bent and broken, but I am unbowed and unbroken. I will take what is mine with fire and blood.

[The scene cuts to the destruction continuing. The army sets fire to the Red Keep. The scene cuts to Jaime and Cersei.]

Jaime: (to Cersei) We have to leave.

Cersei: (to Jaime) I will not leave you.

Jaime: (to Cersei) You have to.

Cersei: (to Jaime) I will not.

[The scene cuts to Arya, who is running through the city. She sees the Hound.]

Arya: (to the Hound) Come with me.

Title: "Shadows of the Old Gods"  
Season 9, Episode 1

[Scene 1: Winterfell Courtyard]
The camera pans over the bustling courtyard filled with people readying their horses. A cold wind blows as Sansa Stark stands on a platform addressing the gathered Northerners.

Sansa: "The Long Night has passed, but the cold remains. We have survived by the strength of our unity, and we will continue to do so."

The crowd cheers, and Jon Snow steps forward, his eyes scanning the gathering.

Jon: "The realms of men have faced dark times, but we rebuild. With allies from all corners of Westeros, we will secure a future for generations to come."

[Scene 2: King's Landing Throne Room]
Daenerys Targaryen sits on the Iron Throne, now redecorated with dragon motifs. Tyrion Lannister stands beside her, a parchment in his hand.

Daenerys: "We have secured alliances, but challenges remain. The legacy of the Iron Throne is one of power and justice. Let it be known, King's Landing will rise stronger."

Tyrion: "Queen Daenerys has decreed that new laws of governance be established, ensuring fairness and equality."

[Scene 3: The Wall]
A small gathering of Wildlings and Night's Watch members stand together, looking over the Wall.

Tormund Giantsbane: "We've seen what lies beyond, and we've fought side by side. The Free Folk are bound no longer by chains but by friendship."

Samwell Tarly: "With the histories in hand, we will rebuild the Watch, not just as protectors, but as guides between realms."

[Scene 4: Dragonstone]
Arya Stark examines a map, a newfound determination in her eyes. She speaks to her new crew of explorers.

Arya: "We sail beyond the maps, to lands unseen. Our journey begins from the harbors of Dragonstone, where each wave takes us to the edge of the world."

[Closing Scene: A mysterious forest in the Nightlands]
Bran Stark, surrounded by the ancient trees, looks up at a mysterious constellation in the night sky. His eyes glow briefly as a raven caws, and the screen fades to black.

[End of Episode]
